title: Dependency Injection Fundamentals
summary: Separate object composition from business behavior with explicit, replaceable dependencies.
objectives: Describe why direct dependency creation increases coupling.

reviewCandidates.prompt: What problem does dependency injection solve?
reviewCandidates.answer: It separates object composition from business behavior, reducing coupling and making dependencies explicit and replaceable.
Required dependencies are visible and supplied by the caller, so alternative implementations can be used without changing the consuming class.
